items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: She had a sister named Maude -- Maude Mills.

ctx.x: Yes, oh, very young. She had a sister named Maude -- Maude Mills. Maude tried to make it, but she could never make it. She was a little -- little heavier than -- I mean -- I don't mean physically, but she wasn't dainty like Florence.
Now, Gertrude Saunders, I always felt, listening to Gertrude Saunders, that if -- if she hadn't been black, she might have become an opera singer.
